what_is_tested: Researchers are comparing a new targeted medicine added to standard chemotherapy with standard chemotherapy alone in people with HER2-positive breast cancer at Stage II or Stage III. Treatment lasts about 1 year, with scans and blood tests every 3 months.

include: HER2-positive breast cancer, Stage II or Stage III
ECOG performance status 0 or 1 (able to do most daily activities)
exclude: Prior treatment with a HER2-targeted therapy
Heart function (left ventricular ejection fraction) below 50%

original.summary: This study compares a new targeted medicine added to standard chemotherapy with standard chemotherapy alone. People with HER2-positive breast cancer at Stage II or Stage III may take part. Participants receive treatment for about 1 year and are checked with scans and blood tests every 3 months.
original.eligibility: Inclusion Criteria: Adults aged 18 years or older; Confirmed HER2-positive breast cancer, Stage II or Stage III; ECOG performance status 0 or 1. Exclusion Criteria: Prior treatment with a HER2-targeted therapy; Heart function (left ventricular ejection fraction) below 50%; Pregnant or breastfeeding.
